title: SE JE ÁKÁSHE SÁGARE VANE KÁNTÁRE
BANDHU ÁMÁR BOLTITE PÁRO KON DESHETE THÁKO
JÁHÁ KICHU CÁO TÁHÁ KARE JÁO
ÁMÁR MANER MÁNUŚ TUI KOTHÁ GELI
ÁBÁR KII RE ÁLO ELO DHULOR E DHARÁ TE
OGO AJÁNÁ PATHIK TOMÁY ÁMI BHÁLOBÁSI
ÁMI, BHÚLE GECHI SEI DIN KŚAŃ
TOMÁRE NIBHRITE ÁMÁR KARE NITE CÁI
TOMÁR SAUNGE, TOMÁR SAUNGE MOR PARICAYA
TUMI JE PATH DIYE GIYE CHILE PRIYA
TOMÁRI DEOÁ SURE TOMÁRI BHÁŚÁ BHARE
ÁMI BASE ÁCHI NADII TIIRE TÁHÁRI ÁSHÁY
KENO ÁSO NÁ BHÁLO KI BÁSO NÁ
TOMÁR CARAŃ TALE ATAL ANAL DOLE
JÁTE HO KAHÁN, RAHATE HO KAHÁN
BHÁNUR KIRAŃ ÁCHE AŃUR PARÁŃ MÁJHE
